title: Grounding churn traced to a stale GLOBAL hunch binary in the post-commit hook
observation: Three CI release-gate failures across 2026-08-04..06 ('the working tree changed during release verification') were attributed to a flush seam and partially patched (b736986). The real cause was VERSION SKEW: .git/hooks/post-commit invokes the GLOBAL install at %APPDATA%/npm/node_modules/@davesheffer/hunch/dist/cli/index.js, which was still 1.9.4 — predating the findings feature. Every auto-capture regenerated the committed grounding docs with a renderer that has no findings count, while manual refreshes (local dist 1.10.1) put it back, and CI (repo source) regenerated it again — so the tree could never be stable. Evidence: the counts line across commits — 39f12dd '144 decisions … 1 open findings' (manual), 96665f5 and d7eb334 '145/147 … 3 policies' (hook-written, suffix dropped), c2e45da '149 … 1 open findings' (manual). Resolved by npm i -g @davesheffer/hunch@latest (1.9.4 -> 1.10.1); no EBUSY. The b736986 heal remains valid for the block-only-dirt class it actually addresses, but it was not the cause here.
evidence: git show <sha>:CLAUDE.md counts line across 39f12dd / 96665f5 / d7eb334 / e285acc / c2e45da
npm ls -g @davesheffer/hunch: 1.9.4 before the fix, 1.10.1 after
